SysCron.name: DynamicRoleSync
SysCron.description: Re-evaluate each role's dynamic_filter and refresh the DYNAMIC user_role rows. PerTenant: the scheduler fans out one message per active tenant; user-starter's UserMaintenanceCronConsumer runs syncAll under that tenant context.

SysCron.name: DropStalePushDevices
SysCron.description: Nightly. Removes APP push-device registrations not seen for a session's lifetime (seven days): their session has ended on its own, which announces nothing. Senders already skip them; this only keeps the table small.
